edges.notes: plain axios.post("/api/forgot-password", { email }), root-relative; client/vite.config.js proxies /api to http://localhost:5000 (server/server.js PORT || 5000), and in production the same server serves client/dist. No router registers /forgot-password (authRoutes has only login, register, logout), and app.get("*") answers GET only, so a POST reaches no route

apiClient (line 75) .get('/api/userinfo') chained on line 76. apiClient = axios.create({ baseURL: "/" }) in client/src/apiClient.js, so the URL stays /api/userinfo; Vite proxy /api -> http://localhost:5000. server/server.js mounts userRoutes at /api; router.get("/userinfo")
apiClient.get('/api/problems') in Promise.all after userinfo; base "/", proxied to :5000. problemRoutes mounted at /api; router.get("/problems")
apiClient.get('/api/submissions') in the same Promise.all; submissionRoutes mounted at /api; router.get("/submissions")
apiClient (line 137) .get(`/api/problems/${problemId}`) chained on line 138; base "/". problemRoutes mounted at /api; router.get("/problems/:id")

handleEvaluate: apiClient (line 162) .post(`/api/problems/${problemId}/evaluate`, { userQuery }) chained on line 163; problemRoutes (mounted first) has no POST, so it reaches submissionRoutes' router.post("/problems/:id/evaluate") under /api
refresh after a correct answer: apiClient (line 171) .get('/api/submissions') chained on line 172; router.get("/submissions") under /api
fetch("/api/userinfo", { credentials: "include" }), root-relative, no method so GET; Vite proxy /api -> http://localhost:5000. userRoutes mounted at /api; router.get("/userinfo")
plain axios.get('/api/leaderboard'), root-relative, proxied to :5000. server/server.js mounts leaderboardRoutes at /api (after apiRateLimiter); router.get("/leaderboard")
apiClient.post("/api/login", …); base "/", proxied to :5000. server/server.js mounts authRoutes at /api (after authRateLimiter); router.post("/login")
plain axios.post("/api/register", …), root-relative, proxied to :5000; authRoutes mounted at /api; router.post("/register")

checkAuthStatus: apiClient.post('/api/status'). The file imports '../apiClient' (client/apiClient, which doesn't exist; the instance is client/src/apiClient.js) and nothing imports auth.js, but either way the root-relative /api/status reaches no route: authController exports status, but authRoutes never registers it, and app.get("*") answers GET only
confirmLogout: apiClient.post("/api/logout", {}, { withCredentials: true }); apiClient from ../apiClient (client/src/apiClient.js, base "/"). authRoutes mounted at /api; router.post("/logout")
